Scene:
  Type: Sparse, decaying industrial district
  Time: Amber dusk
  Atmosphere: Hazy air; deep blue-black shadows
  Ground: Flat, largely featureless pale-beige plane stretching between isolated structures

  Elevated roadway:
    Width and direction: Broad; lengthwise through district
    Supports: Regular concrete piers

  Rail viaduct:

    Construction: Rusted steel, exposed trusses, dark tracks
Building organization:
  Count: Roughly twenty-five brick warehouses, workshops, tenement-like blocks
  Placement: Along both corridors; broad empty lots and unfinished-looking gaps
  Outer area: Several larger freestanding mill buildings
  Central crossing: Smaller sheds packed nearby
  Overall pattern: Low-rise, fragmented, irregularly spaced; denser around rail junction, markedly emptier toward perimeter
Building specification:
  Typical form: Most rectangular, two to four stories
  Walls: Red or faded tan brick; weathered plaster patches
  Windows: Repetitive and dark
  Roofs: Flat or gently pitched; rust-streaked
  Cornices: Occasional decorative
Utilities and details:
  Streets: Wooden utility poles and dense sagging overhead wires
  Beneath viaduct: Chain-link fencing and graffiti-covered metal barriers
  Other elements: Exterior fire escapes, narrow catwalks, suspended industrial pipes, rooftop vents, service doors, steps
  Between buildings: Shadowed passages
Occupancy and surroundings:
  Streets and yards: Empty of people and vehicles
  Vegetation: None
  Surface detailing: Little visible
  Distant edges: Thin, hazy silhouettes of a modern city skyline
